description: Check the stock knowledge base without changing it: paths resolve, indexes match contents, every packed tool and aos command has its own node, declared error codes, development leftovers and sizes. One problem per line, then the total.

root.description: Knowledge base root. Default: HOME/knowledge. Relative paths start at AOS_WS, else the current directory.

home.description: The proto8 folder whose lib/packs, cmd, impls, templates and kernel are checked. Default: AOS_HOME, else the proto8 this tool is in.

only.description: Run only these checks. Default: all.

json.description: Print one JSON object (problems, errors, warnings) instead of lines.

max_file_bytes.description: Size warning above this many bytes per .json file. Default: 8192.

max_text_bytes.description: Size warning above this many bytes per text value. Default: 1024.
